## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (unhealthy in all regions, error rate 0.18).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` showed v2.3.1 unhealthy in all regions; `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback. (The first create attempt timed out, but the incident was confirmed created.)

**Final state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
